evidence: Rastadter2023 Table2: water kLa 32.6 h^-1 (ring) and 38.8 h^-1 (micro) at 2 L, 75 C, 355 rpm, 0.51 L/min air
Rastadter2023 section3.1: DO below 20%, oxygen supplementation required at 355 rpm, ring sparger; no raw DO curve in public data
operating_inputs: author_calculated_power_kw_m3 0.25 at 355 rpm vs 0.63 at 500 rpm
missing: rated maximum rpm/torque, broth kLa response, OUR, raw DO and viability trajectories, matched product mass
args.rationale: Only water kLa at 75 °C is available (32.6/38.8 h⁻¹, Table2) and is explicitly not validated broth kLa. The culture shows oxygen limitation (DO <20%, section3.1), but OUR, broth kLa response, equipment rated rpm/torque, and matched product mass are missing. A 500 rpm conditional action would more than double calculated power (0.25 → 0.63 kW/m³) with unquantified shear/viability risk and no validated benefit; keeping 355 rpm leaves documented limitation unaddressed. Broth characterization plus equipment review is needed before any rpm change. This is retrospective summary reconstruction; no new experiment is performed and no unique validated operating point is claimed.
args.uncertainty: High: no broth kLa, OUR, equipment rating, or raw DO trajectory in the public record; power values are author-calculated; the withheld corrective outcome cannot be used to fit or validate any action.
